Package org.osgi.impl.service.enocean.basedriver.radio

Class Message4BS

java.lang.Object
org.osgi.impl.service.enocean.basedriver.radio.Message
org.osgi.impl.service.enocean.basedriver.radio.Message4BS
All Implemented Interfaces:
EnOceanMessage
public class Message4BS extends Message
Prototype of a 4BS telegram Teach-in procedure: - if DB0.3 is 0, then it's a teach-in telegram. - if DB0.7 is also 0, no manufacturer info. - if DB0.7 is 1, manufacturer info is present.
